{{Top|leg}}
'''Boarding disks''' were used by individuals to prove they had purchased passage on a particular [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. [[Mardig]] presented his boarding disk to [[Tri-Planetary Atmospheric]] attendant to board a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] flight to [[Carsanza]].
